calculation.expression: rank_pct((-(log(close/close[-10])) / rolling_std(log_return,20)) * clip(cross_asset_dispersion_10d / rolling_median(cross_asset_dispersion_10d,60),0.5,2.0)); demean cross-section and 2-day smooth
calculation.description: Fade each asset's prior 10-session return after volatility scaling, with signal strength gated by the prevailing cross-asset 10-day dispersion relative to its 60-session median. Cross-sectional percentile ranks, demeaning, and two-day smoothing reduce outlier and scale effects.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark-wide absolute daily paper IC and ICIR gates on the 15-asset universe. Recent 365d and 750d results are strong; 1260d ICIR is below threshold, so monitor regime drift. IC uncertainty is material given approximately 11 instruments per date.
